title: Inbox and WhatsApp fixes: attached photos, captions and Save this number
text: Photos a client attaches in Gmail no longer vanish when you open the email from our stored copy: the picture or file chip shows again. The AI Worker can now read those photos too, and the worker's email-thread reader lists attached files. In WhatsApp, 'Save this number as...' starts with the name WhatsApp already gave, captions under photos and videos are shown, and a long message no longer pushes the Edit and Confirm & Send buttons off the screen.
